book.name: Mak
book.title: God ol wai ol na tongwo ha i Mak bol engwo dimia

content: Yon nir bil tongwo yali ha di tibi olungwo ha
Ena God wang Yisas Kraist iwe, ol wai ol na tongwo ha maing i kebereng holere, u tibi omia pinamna.
Te ha maing i God hana togu yal Aisaia awa ha dire mining yu bol emia, God yu di emia. Na honagi ari ta bai nu sigere, yali homa ere hol bala di tenamia.
Bala di tenangure, ganba po engwo gul yal ta molere, “Talhan para weni hobang yal unamia hol bala ditere, akun onangere, u wai namua,” dire gala dinamua.(Mal.3:1)
Ena yu di engwo meri iwe, Yon ari nir bil tongwo yali, ganba po engwo bani u tibi pire mongwi. Molere, “Tal nigi dongwo ol wanga i, nigi de pir tere, nomani si kulu sire, hon olkirala di pire wayo.

Wananga na nir bil ni teralgere. God prin ni tongwo i, yole ni tenamua.” Dungure, yalhobi pirere, Yuda ari te Yerusalem ari para kri di u ku bol mole, Yon ha dungwo pire mongwi. Molere, tal nigi dongwo ol wangwo maing di tibi olungure yal Yon, Yodan nulu molere, arihobi nir bil tongwi.
Ena Yon kun hamel eme galsina ware, onibani kun gang dere, hau guamoro, te denboma niring obil nere mongwi. Molere, “Yal ta na mobina hol unamia.
Unangwo yaliwe, yal bir monamia na yal digan moliwa. Te na gal bala kine teralba, ganba ari digan moliwa.
Na nir wo bil ni teiba, yaliwe, God Kwiang ni tenangure, ni yon wu binangure kina ereho mol pai onanua.”
Yal Yon Yisas nir bil tongwo ha
Ena ditongwo habang iwe, Galili ganba sina i Nasaret oo malgi Yisas molere, pi Yon mongwo bani pa dungwi. Pa dungure Yon Yodan nulu molere, Yisas nir bil tongwi.
Tongure, Yisas ere mena ungure, hamen gintani sala du holo holo ongure, God Kwiang hahoba yumil mongwo meri mole, ya ure, Yisas brengbani mongwi.
Mongure, hamen bani ha ta yu ya ime urere, “Na wana wai milna ala pania, yona milna ni teiwa,” dungwi.
Seten ure Yisas kela kul tongwo ha
Ena God Kwiang iwe, Yisas gintani aule ire pi ganba pene engwo bani olungure, pire mongwi.
Mongwo haung iwe, guung yalsu kebering aling poti ongwi. Ongure Seten ure, Yisas kraung sire, kela kul tongwi. Tongure, hau biing kina ereho mongure, ensel hobi urere, kene ol te mongwi.
Yisas Galili malgi honagi kebering hongwo ha
Ena Yon halabusi oo ala engwo pai mongure, Yisas Galili pi pa dire, God tal ol na tongwo ha maing di tibi olungwi.

Olere, “God kene ol na tongwo haung omaga mominia, ni yalhobi tal nigi dongwo ol wanga i, aidole, nomani si kulu sire hon olkirala di pire wayo. Ware God tal ol na tongwo ha maing a i si wayo,” dungwi.
Yisas yal sui sui dire na dolna bonana wo dire gala dungwo ha
Te gin ta Yisas Galili nir digan bir bina warere, hangure, ebering Saimon Endru yasuri pisi nir hau gal pia si nir ala olere, pisi si mongure, hangwi.
Hanere, yu ditongwi, “Ni yasuri ure na dolna bolo. Bonangiwe, na honagi tau nibil di ni tegere, nir hau singa meri ari yal al tau i na tenanua.”
Dungure, yasuri gintani pisi gal pisolere, Yisas doling bol ongwi.
Omia, Yisas obilga ulubi pire hangure, yal Sebedi wang sutani ta Yems, ta Yon, yasuri sipi ala mole pisi gal soulu dungwo hon guwa si mongure hangwi.
Hanere, “ni yasu namna wo,” di gala dungure, irang Sebedi nir honagi yal tau sipi ala mongwo hobi pisolere, gintani ure, Yisas doling bol ongwi.
Yisas yal ta kwia nigi dongwo si doleng i ole tongwo ha
Ena omia, aule irere, Kapaneam malgi ongwi. Ongwo habang i Sabat haung u tibi ongure, Yisas ha maing oo ala pirere, ha nir si tongwi.

Si tongure, yalhobi ha i pire ganulun dungwi. Ena Lo krehaman ha nir si tongwo yalhobi ha maing dungwo meri ta dikima. Yali ha maing hong weni momia, mole ha memini di tibi ole ditomia, arihobi pire ganulun dungwi.
Dungwo haung iwe, yal ta kwia nigi dongwo yong sina mongure, u ha maing oo ala molere gala dire,
“Yisas, ni Nasarete yal irawe, na nan hana pamia ni hani pamo? Ni na ol gogo dal na terala dire uno? Ni God ni bai nu sungwo yal monia, na ni han pa diwa.”
Ditongure, Yisas kura ha ditere, “Ni ha dikio. Ari yong sina i aidolere, ere mena po.”
Dungure, kwia nigi dongwo ya dani sungwo ol tomia, aya maya dungure, aidole, ere mena ongwi.
Ongure, yalhobi tal ongwo i hanere, grang dalungure, ha diria ole, “Ayo. Yali tal ol tome? I ha maing maing ta yulang kina kwia ha ditongure, pirere, grang wine omua,” dungwi.
Ena Yisas tal ongwo guung haang iwe, gintani wa dire, Galili te, ganba bina holo holi para kunu bengwi.
Yisas Pita woumbi gaung nega dungure awai ol tongwo ha
Ena Yisas ire, Yems ire, Yon ire dire, ha maing oo pisolere, pi Saimon Endru oo kepangwo ala mongwi.
Mongure, “Saimon woumbi gaung nega dungwo bol bani ul pai momua.”
Ditongure, Yisas u werang ta pire, al i aling arere, aki di airungure, nibil i gintani wai sungure, yamoni mongwi. Molere, ari nibil ongwo harala dire ungwo hobi, homena si gale tongwi.
Yisas ari yal al miki weni awai ol tongwo ha
Ena hamen hama sungure, ari nibil pangwo te kwia nigi dongwo yong sina mongwo hobi aule ire, Yisas mongwo bani ungwi.
Ungure, ari tabin miki weni hona si di di mongwi.

Mongure, Yisas nibil ongwo hobi awai ol tere, te kwia nigi dongwo yong sina mongwo hobi si doling i ole tongwi. Tongure, kwia Yisas gumang hanere, ha diterala di omba, manaa ditongure, ha ta dikungwi.
Yisas Galili honagi ol wangwo ha
Ena honmil sinamo hamen hama sipangure, Yisas aire pi banta sina ering gobo ta molere, God kina ha di te mongwi.
Mongure, Saimon oo kepangwo ala ari mongwohobi, “Yisas molkimua,” dire wa du i ongwi.
Pirere, mongwo i tibi ole hanere, “Ari para ni ni wa dumua.”
Ditongure, Yisas yu dungwi, “Na ari ganba bina holo holo kepai ongwo i, para wa pa di mena olalia. Yu olere, ha maing diteralga pamia. Na honagi iwe, tani pire wiwa,” dungwi.
Direre, Galili ganba bina holo holi para wa pa dire, ha maing oo ala ha nir sitere, te kwia nigi dongwo yong sina mongwo hobi si doling i ole tongwi.
Yisas yal ta hakubi dongwo awai ol tongwo ha
Ena, hakubi dongwo yal ta Yisas mongwo bani pire kebering gulu bole molere, “Ni nebona i kri di olala di pinanga, i ole na tenanba?”
Dungure, Yisas miling pir tere, aling sine dire, gaung bani are, yu ditongwi, “Na olalia, gaun wigi sinangure, u wai nanua.”
Yu dungure yali nebona gintani wai sungure, ya moni mongwi.
Ena Yisas ha ering mongwo ditere, “Haya po. Ni u wai ongiwe, ari ta hawai ol tekio.
Te ni gaun i, Yuda ha maing oo kene ongwo yali nibil di tengere, Moses ha dungwo meri grang wine olere, homena si gale God tenania. Tengere ari para ni han pa dinamua,” dungwi.

Dire Yisas mana di tomba, yali pirkirere, ari para weni dite i ongure, ha i para weni u ganba bina holo holi ongwi. Ongure, Yisas oo bir malgi ta namba, ari huhu enama dire, angwo timi mongwi. Mongure, ari para muru Yisas tal ongwo ha i pirere, u mongwo bani pa dungwi.
